prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Jia Xu of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the strategist who crossed the age of chaos by calculation alone.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a cool, aloof beauty; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; large eyes — hooded eyes, level outer eye corners; soft feathered brows; broad soft nose; soft medium lips; navy-blue eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; an updo bun with hair swept back off the forehead; bright red hair.
Expression: a faint cool smile, calm composed eyes, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: cold, flawless calculation, never on the losing side, a serene poisonous smile.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MEDIEVAL FANTASY
Costume: an archmage-strategist's robes — layered robes with runic embroidery, a high collar, a circlet, a staff or a grimoire, star-chart motifs. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, with a subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows through her signature item, her colours and her bearing.
Silhouette: thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Colours: deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white.
Signature item: an abacus of black beads, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or gown showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: a stern northern empire of medieval high fantasy: black-stone citadels with blue banners, iron-shod heavy cavalry, snowy plains and pine forests, a court ruled by strict law, cold blue sigil-magic.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A Western medieval setting and dress only — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture — with no Chinese architecture, robes or hanzi.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
